newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes firm despite few enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes firm despite few enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes stayed firm on Thursday despite few enquiries and traders said they did not expect healthy enquiries later in the day.

"Singapore levels are higher than those in other regions, why should shipowners buy here?" said one trader. Suppliers said the strength of the cargo market had made the blending cost high. "Some just don't do any 180-cst grade now," said one.
The 380-cst was quoted at $102/$103 and the 180-cst was at around $108/$109. MDO and gas oil were at $190/$193 and $200/$205 respectively.
